title: NCAA: Mapua outlasts Perpetual Help in OT to extend winning streak
summary: Mapua University pushed its winning streak to five games on Friday after a 65-60 overtime win over Perpetual Help in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament at the San Juan Arena.
